intro.title: Hi! I'm Xuan Lin.
intro.desc1: After moving from chemical engineering into front-end development, I brought my habits of analyzing data and investigating problems into product development. I start by understanding the context and the problem, then break requirements down into features that can be implemented and validated step by step.
intro.desc2: My development experience spans e-commerce platforms, web platforms, and cross-platform iOS and Android apps, including API integration, reusable components, and interactive features. I care about clear user flows and code structures that support future growth.
intro.desc3: I also integrate AI tools into my development workflow to clarify requirements, explore implementation approaches, and troubleshoot issues, checking the results through code review and functional verification. I turn effective practices into repeatable workflows to continually improve how I build.
intro.desc4: To me, good front-end development brings interface details and application logic together to serve users. I aim to combine an engineering mindset, thoughtful user experiences, and AI-assisted development to build products that are easy to use and maintain.
